# Mohammad Firdaus bin Mohd Puzi

> Software engineer's personal portfolio and blog — thoughts, technical explorations, and reflections.

## Homepage sections
- [About](https://frdspuzi.github.io/#about): Bio and background.
- [Gratitude](https://frdspuzi.github.io/#gratitude): A daily gratitude reflection with an AI-suggested prompt.
- [Reclaiming the Algo](https://frdspuzi.github.io/#reclaiming-algo): A curated, swipeable feed of self-improvement YouTube videos, deliberately bypassing the recommendation algorithm.
- [Insights & Writing](https://frdspuzi.github.io/#my-writing): Published Medium articles, plus a daily AI-generated trivia quiz based on them.
- [Photography](https://frdspuzi.github.io/#photography): An interactive canvas of Unsplash photography.
